import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from scene_demo.finish_v1 import vision


def ctx(op="place", **kw):
    sub = {"operation": op, "target": "cup", "phase": "do"}
    if op == "place":
        sub["destination"] = "tray"
    else:
        sub["destination"] = None
    sub.update(kw.pop("subtask", {}))
    base = {
        "user_request": "Put the cup on the tray.",
        "current_subtask": sub,
        "criteria": {"required": ["cup on tray"]},
    }
    base.update(kw)
    return base


BASE = {
    "target_visible": True,
    "destination_visible": True,
    "at_destination": True,
    "supported": True,
    "released": True,
    "stable": True,
    "operation_achieved": True,
    "clear_of_target": True,
    "boxes": {},
    "evidence": [],
    "unknown_reasons": [],
}


def verdict(**kw):
    v = dict(BASE)
    v.update(kw)
    return v


class MockResp:
    def __init__(self, body, status=200):
        self._body = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body
        self._status = status

    def read(self):
        return self._body

    def getcode(self):
        return self._status

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        return False


def resp_body(body):
    return MockResp(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "choices": [{"message": {"content": json.dumps(body)}}],
                "usage": {"t": 1},
                "model": "m",
            }
        )
    )


def write_png(path, data=b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
    Path(path).write_bytes(data)


class GroundingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prompt_semantics(self):
        p = vision.build_prompt(ctx())
        self.assertIn("rotate the stove knob", p)
        self.assertIn("support surface", p)
        self.assertIn("red burner", p)
        self.assertIn("turn/on", p)
        self.assertIn("bowl", p)
        self.assertIn("plate", p)
        self.assertIn("stove", p)
        self.assertIn("current instant", p)
        self.assertIn("Partial occlusion", p)
        self.assertIn("at_destination is False", p)

    def test_no_plan_or_truth_leak(self):
        c = ctx(
            plan_success=True,
            gold="gold-secret",
            native="native-secret",
            sim_truth="sim-secret",
        )
        p = vision.build_prompt(c)
        self.assertNotIn("gold-secret", p)
        self.assertNotIn("native-secret", p)
        self.assertNotIn("sim-secret", p)
        self.assertNotIn("plan_success", p)

    def test_schema_unchanged(self):
        ctx_ok = ctx()
        sub = ctx_ok["current_subtask"]
        self.assertEqual(sub["operation"], "place")
        self.assertEqual(sub["target"], "cup")
        self.assertEqual(sub["destination"], "tray")
        self.assertEqual(sub["phase"], "do")
        self.assertEqual(
            sorted(ctx_ok.keys()),
            ["criteria", "current_subtask", "user_request"],
        )
        expected = [
            "target_visible",
            "destination_visible",
            "at_destination",
            "supported",
            "released",
            "stable",
            "operation_achieved",
            "clear_of_target",
            "boxes",
            "evidence",
            "unknown_reasons",
        ]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(BASE.keys()), sorted(expected))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(verdict(evidence=["x"], unknown_reasons=["y"]).keys()), sorted(expected))

            p1 = Path(d, "a.png")
            p2 = Path(d, "b.png")
            write_png(p1, b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\nA")
            write_png(p2, b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\nB")

                {"frame": 0, "view": "agentview", "timestamp": 1.5},
                {"frame": 1, "view": "wrist", "timestamp": 2.5},
            ]
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"DASHSCOPE_API_KEY": "secret"}, clear=False), \
                 mock.patch(
                     "scene_demo.finish_v1.vision.urllib.request.urlopen",
                     return_value=resp_body(BASE),
                 ) as u:
                c = vision.QwenClient(env_path=Path(d, "nope.env"), max_calls=2)
                c.analyze(ctx(sensor_frames=frames), [str(p1), str(p2)])
                req = u.call_args[0][0]
                body = json.loads(req.data.decode("utf-8"))
                content = body["messages"][0]["content"]
                self.assertEqual(len(content), 1 + 2 * 2)
                self.assertEqual(content[0]["type"], "text")
                self.assertEqual(
                    content[1]["text"],
                    "Image frame=0; view=agentview; timestamp=1.5",
                )
                self.assertEqual(content[2]["type"], "image_url")
                self.assertIn("data:image/png;base64,", content[2]["image_url"]["url"])
                self.assertEqual(
